summary: LEO LIN is a Sydney women's ready-to-wear label selling across wholesale, ecommerce and retail, with the US its strongest market. In May 2026 CEO Joanne Goldman advertised a Financial Analyst under Head of Finance Carina Huang, whose brief centres on month-end close and reconciling data across accounting, ERP and business systems.
